**Step 1 — Scene:** Rice topped with a meat-and-vegetable stir-fry in brown sauce, with a small frosted cake and an amber drink.

**Step 2 — Vessels:** Main plate approximately **25 cm** across: area ≈ **491 cm²**. Dessert plate approximately **20 cm**: area ≈ **314 cm²**. Glass approximately **7 cm** across internally: area ≈ **38.5 cm²**.

**Step 3 — Items:** Cooked rice; browned meat, probably chicken; green beans, carrots and onions; brown sauce with some incorporated oil; frosted cake; amber drink, assumed to be apple juice for the energy estimate. No separate oil quantity is clearly distinguishable.

**Steps 4–6 — Area, volume and weight:** Main-plate coverage is allocated between ingredients to avoid counting overlapping layers twice.

| Item | Vessel area covered | Area × average height = gross volume | Bulk density | Estimated weight |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Rice | 28% | 137 × 1.6 = 219 ml | 0.8 g/ml | 176 g |
| Meat | 22% | 108 × 1.3 = 140 ml | 0.95 g/ml | 133 g |
| Vegetables | 15% | 74 × 1.5 = 111 ml | 0.6 g/ml | 66 g |
| Brown sauce | 5% | 25 × 0.5 = 12 ml | 1.0 g/ml | 12 g |
| Frosted cake | 10% of dessert plate | 31 × 3.8 = 119 ml | 0.65 g/ml | 78 g |
| Drink | Glass cross-section | 38.5 × 5.7 = 219 ml | 1.0 g/ml | 220 g |

Main-plate coverage totals **70%**, consistent with the visible uncovered rim. Cake density includes its crumb structure and frosting.

**Step 7 — Energy:** Rice ≈229 kcal; meat ≈239 kcal; vegetables ≈30 kcal; sauce ≈10 kcal; cake ≈273 kcal; drink ≈97 kcal.

**Step 8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **387 g** on the main plate is plausible for the visible mound. Including cake and drink, the estimate is **685 g and 880 kcal**. The drink is a significant uncertainty: unsweetened tea instead of juice would reduce energy by about 95 kcal.
